role: One post-open Case 19 frame-zero mechanism gate for a deployment-visible, nonlinear, conservative local graph diffusion followed by one unchanged restarted PCGLS step. It is not a Haar or other wavelet continuation, a coordinate-line or voxel-block inverse, a global low-rank tail model, a Sobolev or global-quadratic penalty, or a learned model.
scientific_question: Can a fixed edge-preserving Charbonnier diffusion of the converged K13 field repair the common Case 19 frame-zero interior-gradient blocker while preserving field and observation accuracy and using fewer exact calls than K16?
physical_hypothesis: The independently inconclusive v249 run nevertheless localizes useful diagnostic headroom to removal of unsupported local oscillation before one exact restarted step. A conservative six-neighbour diffusion whose conductance falls with the deployment-visible field jump can suppress small finite-view oscillations while preserving strong plume interfaces more faithfully than an equal-cost linear heat control. This mechanism acts through local flux rather than Haar coefficients or local normal-operator inverses.
design_evidence_boundary: All v244-v249 Case 19 values are already open and may motivate this post-open diagnostic, but no v250 field, scale, conductance, residual, metric, pass count or gate value may be computed before this file is committed. No v250 parameter is selected from a score sweep.

frozen_data_and_geometry.camera_roster: For each rig use the first nine stable IDs in the v209 order, then sort IDs in ascending ASCII order before operator construction.
frozen_data_and_geometry.preprocessing: Reuse the exact v249 frame-zero full-grid parser, float64 trilinear interpolation, one-voxel support and interior-mean gauge.
frozen_data_and_geometry.truth_use: CFD truth generates the synthetic observation and scores four veto metrics only. It never enters K13, graph edges, robust scale, conductance, diffusion, controls, restarted K1, depth or stopping.

graph_and_scale.nodes: Only the 30x14x14 active voxels inside the one-voxel zero boundary.
graph_and_scale.edges: All 16,604 undirected face-adjacent active-active pairs, oriented once from the lower z/y/x index to the higher index, with axes visited in z, then y, then x order.
graph_and_scale.signed_difference: For each oriented edge e=(p,q), delta_e=x_q-x_p.
graph_and_scale.robust_scale: From the initial K13 field only, kappa_raw=median(abs(delta-median(delta)))/0.6744897501960817 over all 16,604 signed edge differences.
graph_and_scale.scale_floor: kappa=max(kappa_raw, 64*float64_epsilon*max(infinity_norm(initial_active_field),1)). No other floor, clip or multiplier is allowed.
graph_and_scale.support_and_gauge: The one-voxel boundary remains exactly zero. After every explicit step subtract the active-cell mean; because only active-active pair fluxes are used, this is a numerical gauge projection rather than a boundary sink.

unique_primary.name: canonical_camera_zero_geometry_jacobi_pcgls_k13_charbonnier_graph_diffusion_t1_restart_pcgls_k1
unique_primary.conductance: At every step and edge use c_e=1/sqrt(1+(delta_e/kappa)^2), with the single kappa frozen from the initial K13 field.
unique_primary.update: For every edge add tau*c_e*delta_e to its lower-index endpoint and subtract the same flux from its higher-index endpoint, accumulate all edge fluxes from the pre-step field, then enforce support and gauge.
unique_primary.stability_reason: The active graph has maximum degree six; tau=1/12 leaves at least one-half self weight when conductance is at most one. Twelve fixed steps give one dimensionless time unit without a result-driven stopping rule.
unique_primary.energy_audit: The Charbonnier edge energy sum(kappa^2*(sqrt(1+(delta/kappa)^2)-1)) must be non-increasing at every step up to 256 float64 eps times max(previous_energy,1).
unique_primary.refinement: Compute the exact projection of the diffused field, then run exactly one standard fixed-SPD reported-geometry diagonal-Jacobi PCGLS iteration from that initializer. No fallback or early stopping.

controls.name: canonical_camera_zero_geometry_jacobi_pcgls_k13_linear_heat_graph_diffusion_t1_restart_pcgls_k1
controls.definition: Use the identical 16,604-edge graph, tau=1/12, twelve steps, support/gauge projection and restarted PCGLS K1 shell, but set every conductance to one. This is the equal-call deterministic smoothing control.

controls.name: canonical_camera_zero_geometry_jacobi_pcgls_k16_reference
controls.definition: Frozen parent reference and same frame-zero blocker.

forbidden_search: No graph, neighbourhood, boundary rule, scale estimator, scale multiplier, conductance family, exponent, step size, step count, diffusion time, edge subset, initializer, depth, preconditioner, camera subset, rig, metric or threshold search is allowed after freeze.

accuracy_gate.control_dominance: If the equal-call linear heat control or cheaper K14 control also passes every frame-zero cell, Charbonnier-specific headroom is not isolated.

independent_validation.method: A second program must rebuild observations and diagonal Jacobi, enumerate the active graph and accumulate pair fluxes with explicit scalar loops rather than the formal vectorized axis slices, rerun all four arms, seal its arrays before reading formal scientific arrays, and recompute energies, metrics, gates and costs.
independent_validation.known_parent_numeric_boundary: v249 independently rebuilt K13 base fields differed by at most 1.5662e-11 relative. v250 does not alter v249; its new transform and final physical fields use fixed prospective 1e-8-scale closure gates consistent with the existing operator-level field gate.

decision_order: Any source, parent, shape, finite, graph, edge count, scale, support, gauge, energy, permutation, call-ledger, replay, seal or formal-independent mismatch gives INCONCLUSIVE_INVALID_CASE19_CHARBONNIER_GRAPH_DIFFUSION_FRAME_ZERO_V250.

If the unique Charbonnier primary fails any of the 13 absolute frame-zero cells, conclude FAIL_CASE19_CHARBONNIER_GRAPH_DIFFUSION_FRAME_ZERO_V250 and close this fixed nonlinear diffusion without a full 429-cell run.

If the primary passes all 13 but the equal-call linear heat or cheaper K14 control also passes all 13, conclude PASS_CASE19_FRAME_ZERO_BUT_CHARBONNIER_ADVANTAGE_NOT_ISOLATED_V250 and do not claim Charbonnier-specific headroom.

Only if the primary passes 13/13, both equal-or-cheaper controls remain incomplete, every ledger and independent check passes may conclude POST_OPEN_CASE19_CHARBONNIER_FRAME_ZERO_HEADROOM_V250 and authorize a separately frozen full 429-cell causal-warm sequence gate.
failure_action: Close the fixed Charbonnier graph diffusion without changing graph, scale, conductance, exponent, step size, step count, diffusion time, support, depth or controls. Do not use a neural model or GPU to rescue it.
